rules.body:
- We want to write as little code as possible to makedebugging easier.
- We want to write explicit code that explains itself.

rules.title: No unsafe Rust
rules.body:
- Never use `unsafe` in Rust code. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` in src/main.rs enforces it, so don't remove it.
- When something seems to need `unsafe` (for example `std::env::set_var` in tests), change the code instead, for example by passing the value in as a parameter.
